title: Finance Office Note on Patronage and Capital Retains for Custom Application and Field Services Spend
content:
Service spend on a plan under Custom Application and Field Services either earns the member a patronage allocation or does not, according to the programme the plan is written on. Where the programme is patronage eligible, capital is also retained per acre worked and credited to the member's equity account under Membership and Patronage Equity.

| Programme | Service spend earns a patronage allocation | Capital retained per acre worked (USD per acre) |
|---|---|---|
| Per-Acre Custom Application | No | 0.0000 |
| Season Commitment Application Plan | Yes | 0.0200 |
| Full-Service Agronomy Plan | Yes | 0.0200 |
| Variable Rate Prescription Plan | Yes | 0.0200 |
| Precision Partner Whole-Farm Plan | Yes | 0.0200 |
| Certified Anhydrous Application Plan | Yes | 0.0200 |

The two figures move together across the range. The Per-Acre Custom Application is the single programme whose spend earns no patronage allocation, and it is the single programme that retains 0.0000 USD per acre worked. The other five are alike on both counts, each earning a patronage allocation on service spend and each retaining 0.0200 USD for every acre worked.

The retain is set per acre worked rather than as a share of the money billed, so two passes over the same acreage at different rates per acre retain the same capital.
